title: fitParameters operation
description: Levenberg-Marquardt regression of thermophysical-model parameters against experimental data, and the SCORING of a package as it stands. Two modes, and the difference matters: `fit` (default) adjusts the listed parameters and writes a fit log (chi^2 and the parameter trajectory per iteration) plus a parity CSV at the optimum; `evaluate` changes nothing and only scores — 'how good are the pairs I already have against MY data?' — so in that mode a `parameters` list is OPTIONAL and, when present, is a pinned what-if whose entries carry `value` rather than the fit vocabulary of initial/min/max.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `fit` (default) adjusts the parameters; `evaluate` only scores the package as assembled. Any other word is REFUSED.

parameters.title: Parameters to vary
parameters.description: One entry per scalar. REQUIRED in `fit` mode (an empty list is refused there); optional in `evaluate` mode. A `fit` entry gives `initial` and usually bounds; an `evaluate` entry gives `value` — mixing the two vocabularies is refused. The scalar is identified either by `path` (dot-separated into the thermophysical system, e.g. `activityModel.pairs[0].a_ij`) or by `name` where the residual's own model names its parameters (e.g. an isotherm's `q_max`).

residual.title: What is being fitted
residual.description: The quantity the residual measures and the data it measures against. `kind` selects the residual family; the remaining keys are that family's own.

kind.title: Residual kind
kind.description: T_bubble (isobaric VLE: the bubble temperature at a fixed P, residual in K), P_bubble (isothermal VLE: the bubble PRESSURE at a fixed T, residual RELATIVE -- for a cubic's kij against high-pressure solubilities; since 2026-10-21, DEV.md 4c C123), isotherm (adsorption). T_bubble+LLE (bubble temperatures AND measured binodal compositions of a partially miscible binary in ONE fit: tie-line datasets `property binaryLLE.binodal;`, `weighting uncertainty` and `liquidLiquid { sigma; origin; }` required, the case's package must declare two liquid phases; since 2026-11-05, DEV.md 4c C226). membrane (a membrane record's transport parameters against measured rejections / fluxes, one operating point per dataset row; since 2026-10-25, DEV.md 4c C149/C152).

T.title: Temperature, when the residual is isothermal (P_bubble)

P.title: Pressure, when the residual is isobaric

model.title: Model being fitted, e.g. langmuir; for kind membrane the transport law: DSPM-DE, SDEM, solutionDiffusion, constantRejection

dataset.title: Dataset file
dataset.description: Path to a self-describing dataset dict, relative to the case.

data.title: Inline data
data.description: Flat grid, as an alternative to `dataset`.

membrane.title: Base membrane record (kind membrane)
membrane.description: The record whose values the free parameters replace and the rest hold fixed (data/standards/assets/ or the case's constant/assets/). A parameter `path` points into it (poreModel.poreRadius, poreModel.chargeDensity, poreModel.porosityOverThickness, poreModel.poreDielectric, A_w, permeabilities.<solute>) or into `transportParameters` (transportParameters.<path>).

rejection.title: Which rejection the data are (kind membrane)
rejection.description: intrinsic: R = 1 - c_p/c_wall (the data were corrected for concentration polarisation); observed: R = 1 - c_p/c_bulk. REQUIRED for kind membrane -- there is no default.

liquidLiquid.title: Weight of the tie-line rows (kind T_bubble+LLE)
liquidLiquid.description: REQUIRED with `kind T_bubble+LLE`. Under `objective.scale.binodal absolute`, `sigma` is the mole fraction judged equivalent to one standard uncertainty of a binodal measurement: each tie-line row is (x_model - x_measured)/sigma, a dimensionless number added to the bubble rows (dT/U) in one chi2; under `relative` (the default) `sigmaRelative` is the same judgement as a fraction of the measured value and each row is (x_model - x_measured)/x_measured/sigmaRelative. `origin` says where that weight came from; a weight with no provenance cannot be told from one tuned after the fit.

sigma.title: Mole-fraction scale of one binodal measurement (objective.scale.binodal absolute)

sigmaRelative.title: Relative scale of one binodal measurement, a fraction (objective.scale.binodal relative, the default)

weighting.title: Residual weighting
weighting.description: kind membrane: absolute (default; a rejection as a fraction, a flux relative) or sigma (the dataset's sigma_<column> columns). Other kinds have their own words.

transportParameters.title: The transport law's own block (kind membrane)
transportParameters.description: Read exactly as the membrane units read it (poreSolver, hindrance, activity, rejection {} ...).

k_film.title: Film mass-transfer coefficient (kind membrane)
k_film.description: A constant film; a large value (10 m/s) for intrinsic data. Exclusive with massTransfer {}.

massTransfer.title: Film correlation (kind membrane)
massTransfer.description: model, its coefficients, viscosity and density -- as the poreTransport bench reads it.

polarisation.title: Polarisation policy (kind membrane)
polarisation.description: suctionCorrection, ionCoupling -- the module's own policy block.

diffusivity.title: Neutral-solute diffusivity for a correlation film (kind membrane)

osmotic.title: Osmotic model (kind membrane, imposed-dP rows)
osmotic.description: model vanHoff (default) or another osmotic model, as the module reads it.

objective.title: Objective (what the fit minimises)
objective.description: DEV.md 4c C280. `method`: leastSquares (Levenberg-Marquardt, the sum of squared scaled residuals), minimax (the LARGEST scaled residual, by Nelder-Mead from the declared start) or twoStage (the DEFAULT: least squares for a first estimate, then minimax from that answer; both answers are kept in the result). `scale` per residual property: T_bubble absolute (kelvin), P_bubble relative, binodal relative (the default; a measured mole fraction <= 0 is refused) or absolute. The run header names the objective and the scales. Fit mode of the bubble kinds only; the isotherm and membrane kinds accept only `method leastSquares`.

maxEvaluations.title: Evaluation budget of the minimax stage (default 1500)

options.title: Solver options
options.description: Levenberg-Marquardt controls. Every one is an explicit, announced aid — never a silent default that hides a hard fit.

output.title: Output files
output.description: Where the fit artefacts go. `proposal` additionally writes a promotable record into the PRIVATE tier (data/local/), never into the curated catalogue — promoting it is a separate, human curation act.

fit_log.title: Iteration history CSV
fit_log.description: One row per Levenberg-Marquardt iteration: chi^2 and the parameter trajectory (fit mode only; refused in evaluate mode).

parity.title: Parity CSV
parity.description: Measured against predicted for every evidence point at the optimum (fit mode) or at the package as it stands (evaluate mode).

proposal.title: Proposal record to write under data/local/

record.title: Fitted record to write (kind membrane)
record.description: constant/assets/<name>.dat of THIS case -- the one home the membrane registry reads; refused under data/standards/ and anywhere else. The record carries the fitted values (6 significant figures, the verdict taken at them), per-value provenance, the uncertainty and a fit {} block of fingerprints that a Process-mode run checks before it uses the record (DEV.md 4c C152).

name.title: The written record's name (kind membrane)
name.description: Defaults to the file stem; may not be the base record's own name.

evidence.description: The FIT / HELD-OUT partition (src/propertyOps/EvidencePartition.H). Each entry names a dataset and DECLARES its role; `role` has no default, and the fitter is handed only the `fit` subset. Mutually exclusive with the legacy single `dataset`.

role.description: fit = regressed against; validation = held out

identity.description: declared identity; fills in what the dataset does not state

dataset.description: The LEGACY single-dataset form: one file, every point fitted, NO validation claimed (src/propertyOps/EvidencePartition.H). Mutually exclusive with `evidence` -- declaring both is refused rather than resolved by an undeclared precedence. Wired into kind=T_bubble on 2026-08-25 so a `mode evaluate` op can SCORE an existing pair against a measured file without transcribing the numbers into the dict; fitNRTL02_thermoml_isobars uses it for its two catalogue controls.

acceptance.description: The acceptance band, DECLARED BEFORE the fit. `origin` is mandatory: a limit with no stated provenance cannot be told apart from one chosen after the residuals were seen.

maxLLE.description: the band of the BINODAL, declared before the fit (kind T_bubble+LLE): the mean absolute deviation of the held-out tie-line mole fractions, dimensionless. REQUIRED when a held-out tie-line dataset is declared; a held-out tie line the fitted model leaves as ONE liquid is a miss of the verdict, never a skip.

origin.description: where the criterion came from (experimental uncertainty, literature tolerance, engineering requirement, plumbing tolerance, ...)
